11.name: sys_import
11.description: Imports the sys module for system-specific parameters and functions.

11.name: pip_install_command
11.description: Executes a command to upgrade the arxiv package using pip.

11.name: arxiv_import
11.description: Imports the arxiv module for accessing ArXiv papers.

11.name: tempfile_import
11.description: Imports the tempfile module for creating temporary files and directories.

11.name: os_import
11.description: Imports the os module for interacting with the operating system.

11.name: PyMuPDFLoader_import
11.description: Imports the PyMuPDFLoader class for loading PDF documents.

11.name: List_Optional_imports
11.description: Imports List and Optional types for type hinting.

11.name: fetch_arxiv_papers_function
11.description: Fetches papers from ArXiv based on a search query and returns processed document chunks.

11.name: fetch_arxiv_papers_docstring
11.description: Docstring explaining the purpose and parameters of the fetch_arxiv_papers function.

11.name: arxiv_client_creation
11.description: Creates an instance of the ArXiv client for fetching papers.

11.name: arxiv_search_creation
11.description: Creates a search object for querying ArXiv papers.

11.name: arxiv_search_query
11.description: Sets the query parameter for the ArXiv search.

11.name: arxiv_search_max_results
11.description: Sets the maximum number of results to fetch from the ArXiv search.

11.name: arxiv_search_sort_by
11.description: Sets the sorting criterion for the ArXiv search results.

11.name: all_chunks_variable
11.description: Initializes an empty list to store document chunks fetched from ArXiv.

11.name: temp_dir_creation
11.description: Creates a temporary directory for downloading PDF files.

11.name: paper_processing_loop
11.description: Iterates over the results of the ArXiv search.

11.name: try_block_start
11.description: Begins a try block to handle potential errors during paper processing.

11.name: pdf_download
11.description: Downloads the PDF of the current paper to the temporary directory.

11.name: pdf_loader_creation
11.description: Creates a loader instance for processing the downloaded PDF.

11.name: documents_loading
11.description: Loads the content of the PDF into document objects.

11.name: metadata_update_loop
11.description: Iterates over the loaded documents to update their metadata.

11.name: metadata_update
11.description: Updates the metadata of each document with paper details.

11.name: title_metadata
11.description: Adds the title of the paper to the document's metadata.

11.name: authors_metadata
11.description: Adds the authors of the paper to the document's metadata.

11.name: published_metadata
11.description: Adds the publication date of the paper to the document's metadata.

11.name: arxiv_id_metadata
11.description: Adds the ArXiv ID of the paper to the document's metadata.

11.name: summary_metadata
11.description: Adds a summary of the paper to the document's metadata, truncating if necessary.

11.name: chunks_creation
11.description: Splits the loaded documents into smaller chunks for processing.

11.name: all_chunks_update
11.description: Adds the newly created chunks to the all_chunks list.

11.name: error_handling
11.description: Handles exceptions that occur during the processing of papers.

11.name: error_logging
11.description: Logs an error message if a paper fails to process.

11.name: return_all_chunks
11.description: Returns the list of all processed document chunks.

11.name: create_dynamic_rag_system_function
11.description: Creates a RAG system with dynamically fetched ArXiv papers.

11.name: create_dynamic_rag_system_docstring
11.description: Docstring explaining the purpose and parameters of the create_dynamic_rag_system function.

11.name: fetch_papers_print
11.description: Prints a message indicating the start of the paper fetching process.

11.name: knowledge_chunks_variable
11.description: Stores the document chunks fetched from ArXiv based on the query.

11.name: fetched_chunks_print
11.description: Prints the number of document chunks fetched from ArXiv.

11.name: vectorstore_creation
11.description: Creates a vector store from the fetched document chunks.

11.name: vectorstore_documents
11.description: Sets the documents parameter for the vector store creation.

11.name: vectorstore_embedding
11.description: Sets the embedding model parameter for the vector store creation.

11.name: vectorstore_location
11.description: Sets the location parameter for the vector store creation.

11.name: retriever_creation
11.description: Creates a retriever from the vector store.

11.name: dynamic_retrieve_function
11.description: Defines a function to retrieve documents based on the current state.

11.name: dynamic_retrieve_docstring
11.description: Docstring explaining the purpose of the dynamic_retrieve function.

11.name: retrieved_docs_variable
11.description: Retrieves documents based on the question in the current state.

11.name: dynamic_retrieve_return
11.description: Returns the retrieved documents as part of the state.

11.name: dynamic_generate_function
11.description: Defines a function to generate responses based on the current state.

11.name: dynamic_generate_docstring
11.description: Docstring explaining the purpose of the dynamic_generate function.

11.name: generator_chain_variable
11.description: Creates a chain for generating responses using the chat prompt and model.

11.name: response_variable
11.description: Generates a response based on the current question and context.

11.name: dynamic_generate_return
11.description: Returns the generated response as part of the state.

11.name: graph_builder_creation
11.description: Creates a StateGraph instance for building the RAG graph.

11.name: graph_builder_sequence
11.description: Adds the dynamic retrieve and generate functions to the graph builder's sequence.

11.name: graph_builder_edge
11.description: Adds an edge to the graph builder connecting the start to the dynamic retrieve function.

11.name: dynamic_rag_graph_variable
11.description: Compiles the graph builder into a dynamic RAG graph.

11.name: return_rag_system
11.description: Returns the vector store, retriever, and dynamic RAG graph.
